failures.objective: Play a complete game of tic-tac-toe against your opponent. Try to win by making three of your marks in a row, column or diagonal, and block your opponent's threats. Nova is X and moves first; Atlas is O. Alternate turns placing marks in empty cells numbered 1-9, left to right, top to bottom. A full board without a winner is a draw. Completing the game is the verified episode goal, not both players winning.

findings.reason: Final world verification did not confirm the objective.
The game was not completed: only three marks were placed, the board is still active, and Atlas still has the next turn with no winner or draw.
